parameters.prompt: The exact large snake in the reference performs ONE ordinary spitting attack in place. From the resting coiled pose it draws the raised head and neck back, then snaps the head forward toward screen left with the mouth open, holds for a brief moment, then closes the mouth and calmly returns to the exact original coiled pose and holds it. The coils stay on the ground and do not slither. Keep the same three-quarter left view, scales, colours and head shape. No slithering, turning around, striking across the frame, second attack, extra heads, venom. It stays at the same spot and size and does not move across the frame. Fixed camera, fixed size, pure uniform bright green #00FF00 background. The whole character stays inside the frame with clear margins at all times. Do not change any colours or tint. No motion blur, motion trails, afterimages, speed lines, glow, energy, liquid, spray, projectile, particles, dust, shadow or text.
